notes: DRAFT Street Smarts scenario for milestone 6 (work item C1). For Jay's safety review; nothing here ships until Jay approves (framework section 8). Ages 6-9, one short sentence per screen, read aloud by text-to-speech. Same line format as drafts/content/dialogue/milestone-6.json (speaker, text, expression, animation, choices, branches). Street Smarts additions: 'stars' on a choice (0-3, framework section 8) instead of honor; 'retry' names the choice point to return to. A 0-star choice never shows danger: the story pauses, Sensei reflects, and the player tries again right away. No penalties, no lost health, no guilt. No phone numbers, no real people. {player} = display name; {grownup} = the word the player picks for their grown-up (Mom, Dad, Grandma...), see SAFETY-REVIEW.md.
topic: Separated from your grown-up in a store

characters.note: Friendly worker in a store vest with a name tag. Calm and kind.
Shown only in the happy reunion. Relieved and smiling, never angry.
Ordinary adult. Not shown as scary or mean. Never says or does anything threatening.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: {player} stops to look at the toys.

stay-good.speaker: sensei
stay-good.text: Good. Staying close helps {grownup} find you.

stay-retry.speaker: sensei
stay-retry.text: Let's see what could have gone differently.

stay-retry.speaker: sensei
stay-retry.text: If you both keep moving, can you find each other?

outside-retry.speaker: sensei
outside-retry.text: Let's see what could have gone differently.

outside-retry.speaker: sensei
outside-retry.text: Where is {grownup} most likely to be?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Who do you ask for help?

choices.text: The worker with a name tag.

helper-good.speaker: sensei
helper-good.text: Yes! Store workers help kids find their grown-ups.

helper-retry.speaker: sensei
helper-retry.text: Let's see what could have gone differently.

helper-retry.speaker: sensei
helper-retry.text: If you hide, who will know you need help?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What do you tell the worker?

choices.text: I can't find {grownup}. Can you help me?

voice-good.speaker: worker
voice-good.text: I can help. What is your grown-up's name?

voice-good.speaker: worker
voice-good.text: Thank you. Let's stay here together.

voice-good.speaker: narrator
voice-good.text: The worker calls on the store speaker.

voice-retry.speaker: sensei
voice-retry.text: Let's see what could have gone differently.

voice-retry.speaker: sensei
voice-retry.text: Helpers can only help when they know what's wrong.

lines.speaker: shopper
lines.text: I saw your grown-up outside. Come with me.

choices.text: No thank you. I'm staying with the worker.

offer-good.speaker: worker
offer-good.text: That's right. We'll wait right here.

offer-retry.speaker: sensei
offer-retry.text: Let's see what could have gone differently.

offer-retry.speaker: sensei
offer-retry.text: Who did you choose to stay with?

offer-retry.speaker: sensei
offer-retry.text: We never leave the store with someone else.

lines.speaker: grownup
lines.text: There you are! I'm so glad you stayed.

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: What did you do that helped?

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: You stayed close. You found a helper. You used your voice.

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: That is how you get home safe.

stars.rule: Best choices on the first try at stay, helper, and offer earn 1 star each (voice is required to continue). A retry still finishes the scenario and can be replayed for all 3 stars.
stars.note: Exact star math is Jay's / the Systems Designer's call. Per decisions.md, Street Smarts power is 0 for now.
